Messages.Author: Henrik
Messages.Body:
Does the diablerizing vampire gain 2X the amount of blood on the burned
vampire?

Card text:
Ritual of the Bitter Rose [Jyhad, V:TES]
Cardtype: Action modifier / Combat

This card {can be played as} an action modifier card {or} a combat card.
{()} Each ready vampire you control gains an amount of blood from the blood
bank equal to the amount of blood on {a vampire being burned either by
diablerie or while in combat with this vampire}.

Messages.Body:

>Does the diablerizing vampire gain 2X the amount of blood on the burned

Why would it?

It just gets the amount on the vampire, as card text states all
qualifying vampires do.

Because diablerization normally gives you the ability to gain as much
blood as was on the vampire. There is no indication that that effect
is nullified, even though "according to the RPG", it should nullify
the effect.
